title: MiniQMT strategy binding freezes historical selection_run instead of enforcing daily selection generation
description: Expected: A MiniQMT virtual strategy should bind StrategyPackage alpha core plus platform runtime release/profile references. Each trading day must generate or resolve the current trade_date SelectionRun from the package alpha core and platform runtime versions before order generation. Historical SelectionRun records are audit/replay evidence only and must not be the long-lived active binding that drives future order generation. Actual: QmtStrategyPackageBindingService.bind_with_result requires selection_run_id and stores selection_run_id/trade_date/top_k/target_weight/runtime_config in qmt_strategy.strategy_package_binding; SelectionOrderBuilder then reads that active binding selection_run_id, risking stale future orders and mixing strategy identity with daily signal evidence.
required_verification: Active MiniQMT strategy binding stores package/runtime references separately from daily selection evidence.
Daily execution fails fast when current trade_date selection evidence is missing, stale, failed, or generated with mismatched runtime version/hash.
Historical selection_run remains available for audit/replay but cannot drive future trading days by default.
closure_requirements: MiniQMT daily execution enforces current-day selection generation or explicit current-day resolution.
Binding rollover no longer requires making a historical selection_run the long-lived strategy identity.
DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 evidence maps each required behavior to implementation references and automated verification.
non_goals: Do not modify production runtime, production DB, port 8001, frontend port 3000, or live MiniQMT session.
Do not redesign Selection Center or Paper v2 beyond the qmt_strategy_ledger daily selection lifecycle needed for this defect.
